problem_spec:
def problem_spec
-- function signature
(implementation: Int → List Int)
-- inputs
(n: Int) :=
-- spec
let spec (result: List Int) :=
  (result.length = n) ∧
  (forall i: Nat, (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ n ∧ Even i) → (result[i-1]! = Nat.factorial i)) ∧
  (forall i: Nat, (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ n ∧ Odd i) → (result[i-1]! = (List.range (i+1)).sum))
-- program termination
∃ result, implementation n = result ∧
spec result
